source_text: Randomized controlled trials in Africa, extrapolated by the CDC, indicate that male circumcision confers a 50-60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition risk, alongside lowered incidence of certain STIs like herpes simplex virus-2, yielding net preventive benefits that persist into adulthood. [59]
